text: This report recommends that the name "Glicksman Glick Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane located west of Widmer Street, extending southerly from Adelaide Street West. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Glicksman Glick Lane" for an existing public lane west of Widmer Street, extending southerly from Adelaide Street West.
